text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi! I'm Daring Heart. Nice to meet you, 
Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What I desire is the Triple Tiara and the 
seat of the supreme Queen, claimed at the 
end of a dazzling clash.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"A tough road ahead? Hehe, isn't that 
thrilling! I'll definitely show you I can 
become the perfect queen. On my 'Daring 
Heart'!"

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
